disclaimer: These are structured starting points, NOT original AI art, verified UX findings or shipped designs.

concepts.name: Editorial flagship
concepts.thesis: Introduce the creator through an editorial identity and establish credibility with long-form project stories.
desktop_wireframe: Identity copy + authentic portrait in asymmetric frame
Featured work as expansive editorial case studies
Expertise, philosophy and contact in distinct reading zones
mobile_wireframe: Identity first; portrait placed below introduction
One immersive project story per section
Compact accessible section navigation and direct contact
concepts.tradeoff: Strong narrative, but lengthy pages require careful navigation and performance testing.
concepts.risk: Long-form reading may slow visitors looking for a specific project.

project_constraints.approved_visual_language: near-black editorial interface, crimson accents, refined asymmetry, controlled motion
project_constraints.approved_identity: MD Faysal Ahmed — Digital Creator | Founder | Web & App Developer
project_constraints.audio: opt-in only when implemented, never autoplay

audience: Visitors evaluating the creator's real projects and responsibilities
Potential collaborators looking for proof of practical web and app work
concepts.project_goal: Present authentic work clearly with a cinematic editorial identity without obscuring project discovery.
concepts.asset_policy: Use only verified project assets; identify missing assets, never fabricate live screenshots, logos, or personal facts.
concepts.scope: Concept-only exploration; no production changes or implementation approval.

concepts.name: Project dossier
concepts.thesis: Make completed work the primary proof, with clear project context and scannable project records.
desktop_wireframe: Compact creator header above selected project
Numbered project rail beside detailed project dossier
Skills and contact in a quiet lower information strip
mobile_wireframe: Concise creator header with work-first CTA
Accessible expandable project dossiers in source order
Expertise and contact under project index
concepts.tradeoff: Fast work discovery, but selected-panel behavior needs keyboard and deep-link support.
concepts.risk: Tab-like interactions may hide details from search engines or keyboard users if implemented poorly.

concepts.name: Cinematic chapters
concepts.thesis: Use distinct narrative chapters to connect the creator's philosophy with selected work without repeating a card grid.
desktop_wireframe: Full-height manifesto with explicit chapter index
Thematic storytelling chapters with project index
Closing invitation with clear contact action
mobile_wireframe: Readable manifesto with visible jump-to-work control
Stacked chapters and numbered project links
concepts.tradeoff: Memorable storytelling, but motion must never obstruct direct access to work.
concepts.risk: Animation-heavy layouts can impair readability, low-power performance and motion sensitivity.
